- Applied the main load_config.rs refactor: parser-backed runtime test helpers now render TOML into the canonical parser, the hand-built RuntimeConfigV2 constructor is deleted, and load_runtime_timing_values now shares parse_runtime_document.
- I also moved the reusable runtime TOML fixture helpers out of mod tests so the public test-support entrypoints and unit tests consume the same render helpers.
- Next: format, then run the Ralph-required validation stack and inspect any compile or test regressions.

- make check failed on dead-code: render_runtime_test_config_toml was only used by the unit-test module, not the internal-test-support feature build.
- Fixed that by tightening the helper to #[cfg(test)] so clippy stops treating it as dead code while the public test-support path still uses the promoted shared fixture helpers.
- Next: rerun cargo fmt and restart the required validation stack beginning with make check.

- The next make check run failed because the unit-test module was still referring to moved helper functions without importing them from super.
- Patched the mod tests import list to pull the promoted helper functions back into scope, which is the intended shape after moving them out of the nested module.
- Next: rerun cargo fmt and make check again, then continue through lint/test/test-long if green.

- make check is now green after importing the promoted helper functions into the unit-test module.
- Net line delta from the Ralph baseline remains strongly negative at -3639 lines.
- Next: run the remaining required targets explicitly: make lint, make test, and make test-long.

- make test found the actual behavior regression: I appended a [process.binaries.overrides] table before later dotted top-level fields, so TOML parsed those later fields as members of the overrides table.
- Fixed that by flattening the runtime test binary overrides back to dotted keys, which preserves the ability to append later top-level settings like postgres.access.hba and ha.loop_interval_ms.
- Next: rerun the required validation stack from make check through make test-long on the corrected TOML rendering.

- The remaining make test failures were all from one shape problem: the shared runtime fixture always emitted postgres.access.hba, and trace_logging_test_config tried to emit it a second time.
- I fixed that by parameterizing the shared runtime fixture on HBA contents and routing the trace helper through the same canonical parser-backed builder with a custom HBA string instead of a duplicate dotted key.
- Next: rerun make check, make lint, make test, and make test-long on the final parser-backed helper shape.

- Validation is fully green on the refactor: make check, make lint, make test, and make test-long all passed after routing runtime test helpers through parser-backed TOML and sharing parse_runtime_document.
